text_block_list.text:
A little before the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Satono Diamond was the first to face her 
opening GⅠ race of the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Dia-chan! The final leg of 
the Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho. It's a 
critical moment... but also a huge 
opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I remember your run last year, 
Kita-chan. That feeling of giving your all 
in your race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because Kita-chan showed me the way— I can 
see the path ahead. No matter what bad 
luck comes, I will definitely overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am Satono Diamond! I was born to fulfill 
the Satono family's cherished dream!
And on that day—
—History has changed.
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond, a flawless victory that 
brushes aside all bad luck! At last, at 
long last, a GⅠ victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The name of the Satono Group's leader has 
been magnificently etched into racing 
history!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your cheers and support. 
I was finally able to make a worthy 
contribution to the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
From now on, the Satono Group will 
continue to stand closely by everyone, on 
and off the racetrack, through racing, 
support, and business ventures.
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

The winner's interview was flawless. 
Satono Diamond conducted herself with 
dignity as the representative of the 
Satono Group.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, yes, yes, 
yeeeeeeeeeeeeeeessssss!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan! Dia-chan, you did it! We did it! 
You really did it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ...! The GⅠ we've been aiming for this 
whole time! It belongs to you, Dia-chan! 
It's the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Tonight calls for a victory toast! No, 
that's not nearly enough at all! 
Kwahhhhhh!!!

She rejoiced even more than if it had 
happened to herself. Rather than sheer 
joy, it was a scream of excitement. 
Meanwhile—

Satono Diamond, who had always been so 
poised, didn't utter a single word. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaah... waaaaahhh, waaaaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonnnn, I really won... I did it. I 
actually did itttt...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been losing over and over... Dia 
is... Dia is such a pathetic girl... I'm 
so... so sorryyyy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You won, though...! Kita-chan, you won! 
Trainer, today... todaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHN!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan is... crying... That... 
Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *sniff*, Daiya-chaaaan!!!!!

The two held each other in their arms. 
Hugging tightly, they became as one.

—A shared destiny. Fighting alongside 
Kitasan Black across the seasons, Satono 
Diamond finally achieved her dream.

"And now the stage moves on to the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa♪ It's time for Umadol Falco's 
weather corner!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the weather for the day of the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, what's with this huge swirling 
spiral~!? A typhoon~!? If something like 
that hits, the stage is gonna get 
wrecked~!!
(WHOOSH! ROAAAARRRR!!)

It wasn't an exaggeration in the 
slightest. The Autumn Tenno Sho was held 
under the worst weather in history. It was 
truly a race in the midst of a storm...

Stepping out onto the stands and looking 
at the track... the entire course was 
buried in misty rain. Running out there, 
visibility would be close to zero.
As I stood there stunned—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, even so... even so, I have to do 
this.

Looking over, Kitasan Black had turned her 
gaze away from the track in a completely 
different direction.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look at the fans in the stands... They 
came all this way, but they look so cold.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single smile in sight. 
Everyone was clenching their teeth, 
bearing through it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, they came for us. To watch us. 
In that case—!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The only way I can respond is through my 
races. Definitely—most definitely!"

Seeing her fans suffering under the fury 
of the typhoon only served to stoke the 
fire within Kitasan Black's heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan made her dream come true. Her 
dream of winning a GⅠ. But I... haven't 
made mine come true yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A dream to make everyone smile! This is a 
trial that I have to overcome!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, the track is terribly 
muddy. What kind of running style could 
possibly make them smile...?!

"Pleasing the fans amidst this storm and 
downpour will be no easy feat. Not unless 
you put on a truly extraordinary race."

"A breathtaking move in such a dire 
situation. If there's a feat that only 
Kitasan Black can pull off—"
choice_data_list:
...Charge in without hesitation, even in 
bad conditions?

...Shall we try charging in without 
hesitation, even in bad conditions?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Charge right in? Even through soaked 
patches and rough ground?
choice_data_list: Yeah, dive right in without fear!

text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps Kitasan Black might be able to 
face these adverse conditions head-on.

If she could throw her innate toughness 
against the rough track and, all on her 
own, come out on top of that contest...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll trust in you, Trainer, 
and dive right in, whether it's puddles or 
the torn-up inside track.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Dia-chan could overcome her jinx, then 
I'll beat this typhoon! For the fans!
